title: A tolerant smile curled his lips.
html_source: A pleasant little pulse of anthropomorphism: the smile—which probably exists somewhere between abstract concept and physical gesture—is given agency, and for a moment takes over Mulligan’s lips. As opposed to Mulligan using a power over his own lips to turn them into a smile.
